messages:
kamal: Heads-up: billing alert from last night. ~1.6k token events never landed in billing topic due to fanout backpressure. Customer slack DMed us.
naomi: Thanks. Any trace ids? which stage returned the 429s?
eric: Fanout worker logs show downstream writer returned 429 on a handful of partitions. Our current behavior is to drop and increment fanout.drops.
yvonne: Dropping is unacceptable for billing. We need either retry semantics or an explicit audit path so reconciler can explain missing events.
kamal: Agree. Quick options: 1) short-lived spill buffer with TTL (ephemeral store) and controlled drain; 2) durable retry queue with backoff; 3) immediate tombstone emission so reconciler knows we dropped.
naomi: Typo: (naomi) Option 1 seems best operationally: bounded storage, gives us a chance to replay, and we can emit tombstones when TTL elapses.
eric: Key constraints: dedupe in billing writer (event_id), worst-case memory usage, and multi-region routing.
yvonne: Proposal detail: write to compact-store key=tenant:event:event_id with TTL=4m, include orig_ts and producer node. Drain consumer group picks them up and writes to billing topic at X rps per tenant. If TTL expires, emit tombstone event: {event_id, tenant_id, reason: "spill_expired"}.
kamal: Metrics: spill.enqueue, spill.drain, spill.expired, spill.backlog. Alerts when backlog total > threshold or expired rate > 0.5% of ingested.
aomi: We need a cap per tenant (e.g., 40k events) to avoid a noisy tenant killing the cluster. After cap, start tombstoning oldest entries.
eric: Reconciler change: tombstones should be treated as explicit gaps; do not auto-fill them. Provide CS with a list of tombstoned IDs for investigation.
yvonne: Multi-region: ensure spills are written into the same partition key used by billing writer. If fanout is cross-region, add a partition_key in the spill metadata.
kamal: Security: store encryption + ACLs. Operational playbook: bump drain workers first, then increase per-tenant drain window, then contact customer.
ci-bot: CI: compact-store TTL integration tests passed; no failing jobs in last 48h.
aomi: Action items: @eric prototype spill write+drain (branch), @kamal add dashboards/alerts, @yvonne draft reconciler/tombstone handling, @naomi to own pilot config and roll plan. Sync Tuesday 11am? :thumbsup:
kamal: Thanks everyone. We'll start with a small pilot and monitor tombstones closely.
